clips.title: The story
paras: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, troggs have driven the miners from their work in the snowy hills of southeastern Dun Morogh. The Ironforge dwarves came for stone and ore, but the excavation has fallen silent.

Gol'Bolar Quarry lies southeast of Kharanos, where Ironforge dwarves came to draw stone and minerals from the mountains. Deep digging opened underground warrens, and hostile troggs drove the miners out. Now the upper camp is a staging ground under siege. Overseers, tradesfolk, and Prospector Gehn gather dwarven and gnomish recruits there to drive back the beasts and reclaim the pit.
